 Alpha insights Both men arrive in Kobe off narrow defeats, but the quality gap tells the story. Nineteen-year-old Max Schoenhaus pushed tour regular Tallon Griekspoor to 6-7 7-6 5-7 in Antwerp — two tiebreaks against far superior opposition — while 31-year-old Billy Harris fell 6-4 6-7 5-7 to Dalibor Svrcina in Shanghai qualifying, his last recorded match back on October 5. Neither is ranked inside the top 150, there's no head-to-head history, and no injury news clouds the picture. The dynamic is youth and rising trajectory versus a decade of challenger know-how plus Harris's 6-foot-4 serve. Schoenhaus's stronger showing and fresher court time give him the slight edge.
